verdict.rationale: Orrick ships software-style legal tech (Tech Studio document generators, Orrick Labs tools), so open-source availability is a fair question. The evidence shows no source code released under an open license. The Tech Studio announcement calls the free forms 'our version of open source' only as a metaphor for free resources, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
